description_en: Sends a security check task to asset servers with one click
description_zh: 对资产服务器一键下发安全检查任务
name: ModifyPushAllTask

parameters.help_en: The IP address of the access source
parameters.name: source_ip

parameters.help_en: The UUIDs of the servers on which you want to perform security checks. Separate multiple UUIDs with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 要进行安全检查的服务器UUID列表。多个UUID之间使用半角逗号（,）隔开
parameters.name: uuids

parameters.help_en:
The check items to include in the security check. Separate multiple check items with commas (,). Valid values:
OVAL_ENTITY: CVE vulnerabilities
CMS: Web-CMS vulnerabilities
SYSVUL: system vulnerabilities
SCA: application vulnerabilities
HEALTH_CHECK: baselines
WEBSHELL: web shells
PROC_SNAPSHOT: processes
PORT_SNAPSHOT: ports
ACCOUNT_SNAPSHOT: accounts
SOFTWARE_SNAPSHOT: software
SCA_SNAPSHOT: middleware, databases, and web services
CROND_SNAPSHOT: scheduled tasks
AUTORUN_SNAPSHOT: startup items
LKM_SNAPSHOT: kernel modules
SCA_PROXY_SNAPSHOT: websites
parameters.help_zh:
要进行的安全检查的检查项列表。多个检查项之间使用半角逗号（,）隔开。取值：
OVAL_ENTITY：CVE漏洞
CMS：CMS漏洞
SYSVUL：系统漏洞
SCA：应用漏洞
HEALTH_CHECK：基线
WEBSHELL：网站后门
PROC_SNAPSHOT：进程
PORT_SNAPSHOT：端口
ACCOUNT_SNAPSHOT：账户
SOFTWARE_SNAPSHOT：软件
SCA_SNAPSHOT：中间件以及数据库、web服务
CROND_SNAPSHOT：计划任务
AUTORUN_SNAPSHOT：启动项
LKM_SNAPSHOT：内核模块
SCA_PROXY_SNAPSHOT：Web站点
parameters.name: tasks

PushTaskRsp.description_en: The result of the security check task execution
PushTaskRsp.description_zh: 安全检查任务执行的结果

PushTaskResultList.description_en: The information about the servers on which the security check task failed
PushTaskResultList.description_zh: 安全检查任务执行失败的服务器的信息

GroupId.description_en: The ID of the server group

InstanceId.description_en: The ID of the server instance

Ip.description_en: The IP address of the server

Message.description_en: The details about the security check task failure
Message.description_zh: 安全检查任务执行失败的详细信息

Online.description_en:
Indicates whether the Security Center agent is online. Valid values:

true: The agent is online.
false: The agent is offline.

If the agent is offline, Security Center cannot provide security protection for the server
Online.description_zh:
云安全中心客户端是否在线。取值：

true：是
false：否

如果客户端不在线，则云安全中心无法对该型服务器提供安全防护

OsVersion.description_en: The operating system version of the server
OsVersion.description_zh: 服务器操作系统的版本

Region.description_en: The region where the server is located

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the security check was successful. Valid values:

true: The security check was successful.
false: The security check failed
Success.description_zh:
安全检查是否执行成功。取值：

true：是
false：否

RequestId.description_en: The request ID, which is a unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request. You can use this ID to troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题
